rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=800, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-3 CONVERGENCE-2. iter-2 (200->400 iters) lifted hr 0.16648->0.21783: the GD data-consistency+TV solve was NOT converged at 200. ONE knob: tv_iterations 400->800 (same lambda=1e-3, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, gd, fbp). HYPOTHESIS: if hr still climbs past 0.21783 the solve is still convergence-limited (keep pushing iters); if it saturates ~0.218 GD has converged at lambda=1e-3 and I pivot to lambda (the strong lever manhart found). Budget: iter-2 ~380s at 400 iters -> ~760s at 800, <<1200s.
